title: Narrow novelty and closest-work differentiation
description: Same-data AgentRewardBench and structurally close WebGraphEval make novelty the primary bottleneck.
mitigation: Use the exact target/unit/access/protocol differentiation and lead with new empirical knowledge rather than method firstness.

title: No independent external benchmark validation
description: Blind official test remains within evaluated benchmark families and does not validate unseen-family transfer.
mitigation: Run a separately preregistered compatible external dataset or narrow title; abstract; and contribution language to within-family held-out evidence.

title: Looping and repetition construct overlap
description: Repetition features directly align with the Looping label and can look tautological despite predictive validity.
mitigation: Emphasize the construct boundary now; a future independent representation or label-validity analysis would be required to resolve it.

title: Original H1 and final structural-signal narrative are not identical
description: The final package narrows dimension-aware benchmark-shift ambitions to evidence the repository can defend.
mitigation: State the narrowed research question early and do not imply that label-specific fusion or unseen-benchmark H1 components were confirmed.

title: Metadata confounding remains
description: Metadata-only grouped models retain non-trivial dev signal and B2 is only descriptively higher.
mitigation: Report exact metadata diagnostics and avoid claiming confounding elimination or significant superiority.

title: Side Effect has low class support
description: Only 12 dev positives support the frozen model and the target remains exploratory.
mitigation: Keep Side Effect outside main confirmatory contributions and state dev/test support and thresholded weakness.

title: Benchmark heterogeneity limits uniform claims
description: Per-family performance varies substantially and AssistantBench is weaker.
mitigation: Present all family results and treat heterogeneity descriptively without pairwise superiority claims.

title: Dense semantic comparison covers one specification
description: One encoder and pooling design cannot establish a general complexity hierarchy.
mitigation: Call B4 a frozen complexity control and preserve uncertain and negative contrasts.

title: Agent/model robustness is model-only and incomplete
description: LOMO shares tasks and one model lacks full benchmark coverage; joint task/model OOD is absent.
mitigation: Label A1.4 exploratory model-only transfer and prohibit arbitrary-agent or joint-OOD claims.

title: Label adjudication and source-license limitations
description: Repeated-label disagreements are excluded but no adjudication hierarchy exists and no standard license identifier is declared.
mitigation: Document target-wise exclusions; audit-only primary labels; and the custom Terms of Use without inferring legal status.

title: Calibration and deployment utility are not evaluated
description: Scores are not calibrated risk estimates and no online or selective-decision evidence exists.
mitigation: Restrict practical claims to offline diagnostics; calibration or deployment evidence requires a new stage.

title: Mechanism evidence is associational and feature-correlated
description: Ablations and coefficients do not identify causal mechanisms and selected errors are illustrative.
mitigation: Use association language; retain correlated-feature caveats; and avoid mechanism or prevalence claims.

title: No frozen target-journal dossier
description: PC6 and target-specific PCS cannot be scored.
mitigation: Freeze a journal dossier in a later authorized stage before making journal-specific competitiveness claims.

title: Journal-specific title formatting and prose remain open
description: Scientific assets are mapped but final title; word limits; section naming; and prose order are not selected.
mitigation: Resolve only after a target journal is frozen and preserve all evidence contracts.

title: Efficiency evidence is environment-specific
description: B2 and B4 timing and memory use different resource domains on one machine.
mitigation: Report hardware; device; repetitions; and resource-domain definitions with no universal cost claim.
